summary: Opera Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, reporting second quarter 2026 earnings. Revenue rose 25% year-over-year to $178.1 million, and adjusted EBITDA reached $42.4 million with a 24% margin, exceeding guidance. The company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. No strategic actions, transactions, or board resolutions regarding deals were disclosed. The filing contains only operational metrics and guidance updates. A conservative review indicates no catalyst for special-situation analysis.
